law.catch_line: Reporting of gang-related criminal information; inclusion in annual Crime in Virginia report
law.text: The Department of State Police shall include arrest statistics for violations of §§ 18.2-46.2, 18.2-46.3, 18.2-46.3:1, 18.2-46.3:3, and 18.2-55.1 in the annual Crime in Virginia report.
